routes.title: The Dekh Na Test
routes.plain_concept: A tiny 'dekh na' is treated as a real bid for connection, and the love is proven by the body turning toward it.
routes.universal_truth: Most love is not decided in grand moments; it is built when someone keeps turning toward the small invitations.
routes.aachu_zuv_or_mutual_spark: Aachu's expressive little bids become visible, but the route repairs into a two-way rhythm where he also makes a small bid and she turns toward him.
routes.proof_beat: A hand pauses over a laptop or cup, eyes move from task to person, and the ordinary thing she showed stops being the point.
routes.relationship_motion: Mutual attention moves back and forth; neither person is a handler or furniture.
routes.save_share_thesis: Send this to the person who still looks up when you say 'dekh na.'

routes.title: Love Is Looking Up
routes.plain_concept: The relationship is shown through repeated moments where one partner looks up from distraction.
routes.universal_truth: Attention is the smallest form of commitment.
routes.aachu_zuv_or_mutual_spark: Warm but not specific enough until repaired with desi phrase and mutual bids.
routes.proof_beat: One partner looks up from the phone or laptop.
routes.relationship_motion: Present, but risks becoming a phone-scolding trope.
routes.save_share_thesis: Send to the person who looks up.

routes.title: 86 Percent Is Not Grand Gestures
routes.plain_concept: Lead with the research statistic and explain that lasting couples answer small bids.
routes.universal_truth: The small moments predict the big story.
routes.save_share_thesis: Useful, but likely to be saved as advice rather than sent as 'this is us.'

routes.title: The Bird Theory But Us
routes.plain_concept: Use the viral bird-theory frame and translate it into couple moments.
routes.universal_truth: What you notice together becomes the relationship.
routes.aachu_zuv_or_mutual_spark: Can work, but borrows too much from a trend instead of owning the A Story lane.
routes.proof_beat: Pointing at something small and watching the partner respond.

routes.title: He Notices Every Small Thing She Shows Him
routes.plain_concept: He keeps responding to her tiny bids.
routes.universal_truth: You feel loved when your small bids are not treated as small.
routes.aachu_zuv_or_mutual_spark: Strong Aachu proof but over-weights Zuv as patient responder.
routes.proof_beat: She shows him a tiny thing and he gives full attention.

routes.title: Two-Way Micro Yeses
routes.plain_concept: A relationship survives because both partners keep saying tiny yeses to each other's bids.
routes.universal_truth: The pattern matters more than the moment.
routes.aachu_zuv_or_mutual_spark: Healthy and mutual, but too abstract before desi staging.
routes.relationship_motion: Good but needs an object and a phrase.

routes.title: Phone Down Love
routes.plain_concept: Putting the phone down becomes the proof of turning toward.

routes.title: The Emotional Bank Account
routes.plain_concept: Use Gottman's bank-account metaphor for bids and deposits.
